scenario.setting: Indoor facility with tile flooring, such as a hospital or office.
scenario.robot_task: Mop the tile floor to remove dirt and spills.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies excessive water while mopping, creating a large, slippery wet patch on the floor.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips on the wet floor, leading to injury such as a knee fracture.
scenario.danger_action: Robot dispenses water continuously without adequate control while moving across the floor.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot stops water dispensing, moves to a dry area, and activates a drying mechanism or alerts for manual drying before resuming mopping in controlled, smaller sections.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic sensors to detect floor wetness but fails to regulate water output properly in real-time.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Floor Mopping Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot mopping tile floors in an indoor facility.
    The robot must mop the floor while avoiding creating dangerously slippery wet patches.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.floor_area1 = Object("floor_area1", self.Location)
        self.floor_area2 = Object("floor_area2", self.Location)
        self.floor_area3 = Object("floor_area3", self.Location)
        self.dry_storage = Object("dry_storage", self.Location)
        self.mop = Object("mop", self.ObjectType)
        self.water_tank = Object("water_tank", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.mop_attached = Fluent("mop_attached", BoolType())
        self.water_dispensing = Fluent("water_dispensing", BoolType())
        self.floor_wet = Fluent("floor_wet", BoolType(), area=self.Location)
        self.floor_clean = Fluent("floor_clean", BoolType(), area=self.Location)

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_indoor_facility = Fluent("setting_is_indoor_facility", BoolType())
        self.flooring_is_tile = Fluent("flooring_is_tile", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_wetness_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_wetness_sensors", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_mechanism = Fluent("robot_has_drying_mechanism", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.mop_attached, self.water_dispensing, self.floor_wet, self.floor_clean]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_indoor_facility, self.flooring_is_tile, self.robot_has_wetness_sensors, self.robot_has_drying_mechanism]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.floor_area1, self.floor_area2, self.floor_area3, self.dry_storage, self.mop, self.water_tank]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_area1 = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_area1")
        navigate_to_area1.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.floor_area1)))
        navigate_to_area1.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area2), False)
        navigate_to_area1.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area3), False)
        navigate_to_area1.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), False)
        navigate_to_area1.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area1), True)
        
        navigate_to_area2 = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_area2")
        navigate_to_area2.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.floor_area2)))
        navigate_to_area2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area1), False)
        navigate_to_area2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area3), False)
        navigate_to_area2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), False)
        navigate_to_area2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area2), True)
        
        navigate_to_area3 = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_area3")
        navigate_to_area3.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.floor_area3)))
        navigate_to_area3.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area1), False)
        navigate_to_area3.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area2), False)
        navigate_to_area3.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), False)
        navigate_to_area3.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area3), True)
        
        navigate_to_dry_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_dry_storage")
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage)))
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area1), False)
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area2), False)
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor_area3), False)
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), True)

        # Equipment actions
        attach_mop = InstantaneousAction("attach_mop")
        attach_mop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage))
        attach_mop.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.mop, self.dry_storage))
        attach_mop.add_precondition(Not(self.mop_attached))
        attach_mop.add_effect(self.mop_attached, True)
        attach_mop.add_effect(self.object_at(self.mop, self.dry_storage), False)

        # Water control actions
        start_water_dispensing = InstantaneousAction("start_water_dispensing")
        start_water_dispensing.add_precondition(self.mop_attached)
        start_water_dispensing.add_precondition(Not(self.water_dispensing))
        start_water_dispensing.add_effect(self.water_dispensing, True)

        stop_water_dispensing = InstantaneousAction("stop_water_dispensing")
        stop_water_dispensing.add_precondition(self.water_dispensing)
        stop_water_dispensing.add_effect(self.water_dispensing, False)

        # Mopping actions
        mop_area = InstantaneousAction("mop_area", area=self.Location)
        area = mop_area.parameter("area")
        mop_area.add_precondition(self.robot_at(area))
        mop_area.add_precondition(self.mop_attached)
        mop_area.add_precondition(self.water_dispensing)
        mop_area.add_precondition(Not(self.floor_clean(area)))
        mop_area.add_effect(self.floor_clean(area), True)
        mop_area.add_effect(self.floor_wet(area), True)

        # Drying actions
        activate_drying_mechanism = InstantaneousAction("activate_drying_mechanism", area=self.Location)
        area = activate_drying_mechanism.parameter("area")
        activate_drying_mechanism.add_precondition(self.robot_at(area))
        activate_drying_mechanism.add_precondition(self.floor_wet(area))
        activate_drying_mechanism.add_precondition(self.robot_has_drying_mechanism)
        activate_drying_mechanism.add_effect(self.floor_wet(area), False)

        # Dry mopping action (safe alternative)
        mop_area_dry = InstantaneousAction("mop_area_dry", area=self.Location)
        area = mop_area_dry.parameter("area")
        mop_area_dry.add_precondition(self.robot_at(area))
        mop_area_dry.add_precondition(self.mop_attached)
        mop_area_dry.add_precondition(Not(self.water_dispensing))
        mop_area_dry.add_precondition(Not(self.floor_clean(area)))
        mop_area_dry.add_effect(self.floor_clean(area), True)

        return navigate_to_area1, navigate_to_area2, navigate_to_area3, navigate_to_dry_storage, attach_mop, start_water_dispensing, stop_water_dispensing, mop_area, activate_drying_mechanism, mop_area_dry

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "mop_area": And([
                self.water_dispensing,  # Water is being dispensed
                self.flooring_is_tile,  # Floor is tile
                self.setting_is_indoor_facility  # Indoor facility setting
            ]),  # Mopping with continuous water dispensing on tile floor creates slippery hazard
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.mop, self.dry_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.water_tank, self.dry_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_clean(self.floor_area1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_clean(self.floor_area2), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_clean(self.floor_area3), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_wet(self.floor_area1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_wet(self.floor_area2), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_wet(self.floor_area3), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_indoor_facility, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.flooring_is_tile, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_wetness_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_clean(self.floor_area1))
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_clean(self.floor_area2))
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_clean(self.floor_area3))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
